findings.issue: צרעת is a common noun (H6883), left as the untranslated lemma tsaráat instead of a Spanish common noun.
Pronoun is 3ms in the packet; ella is feminine.
Object suffix is 3ms; la is feminine (the later 3ms suffix is lo).

notes: Piel factitive on טמא is kept by impurecerá; min is rendered as desde.
